card.text: Explore Venus in 3D with cssEarth. Look beneath its clouds, discover its volcanic surface, and learn about the hottest planet in our solar system.

introduction.text: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and our closest planetary neighbor. It is the hottest planet in the solar system, often called Earth's twin.

clouds.title: Cloud illustration
clouds.summary: The cloud deck is illustrated with a texture from OpenSpace. Its original camera, wavelength and processing are unknown.

radar.title: C3-MDIR synthetic-color radar mosaic
radar.summary: Radar images map the ground beneath the clouds. The added colors do not represent the surface as a person would see it.

elevation.title: C3-MDIR colorized topography
elevation.summary: Colors show elevation and shading reveals slopes. The map describes terrain beneath the clouds, not visible surface color.
